description: This file defines a Flutter widget called SummaryTiles which displays three summary tiles: Income, Expenses, and Net. Each tile shows a label and a value with specific styling and colors.

classes.name: SummaryTiles
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays three summary tiles for income, expenses, and net values.
